Associate Manager - Cashier | MAF Retail | Kuwait

The Associate Manager - Cashier is responsible for assisting the Central Cashier office Manager with the management of all cash transactions within the store. The role holder is also responsible for observing the quality of services being offered to customers in the stores.
Ensure the collection of the sale cash deposit with compliance to Central Cashier Office procedure.
Check and review all the daily reports with compliance to Central Cashier Office procedure.
Ensure the proper conservation, utilization and profitability of the section’s assets.
Ensure that each customer receives outstanding service by monitoring a friendly cash line environment.
Maintain and ensure staff awareness of all promotions and advertisements.
Ensure that all Central Cashier Office assets are in good functioning condition.
Enforce the security and safety procedures.
q: 2+ years in the related department, 1+ year in the retail business.

d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

r: Perform polishing of stainless steel, brass, copper, chrome, aluminum, and other metal surfaces throughout the hotel.
Polish and maintain marble, wooden surfaces, furniture, fixtures, and decorative items as required.
Maintain the appearance of door handles, elevator panels, handrails, metal fixtures, and other engineering-related installations.
Use appropriate polishing machines, tools, chemicals, and cleaning materials safely and effectively.
Inspect polished surfaces regularly and report any damage, scratches, corrosion, or deterioration to the Engineering Supervisor.
Ensure all polishing equipment and tools are properly cleaned, maintained, and stored after use.
Follow the hotel's cleaning schedules and preventive maintenance programmes.
Coordinate with the Engineering and Housekeeping teams to ensure assigned areas are maintained according to hotel standards.
Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures when handling chemicals and operating equipment.
Maintain proper storage and usage of polishing materials to avoid unnecessary wastage.
Respond to polishing and maintenance requests from other departments as assigned.
Perform any additional duties assigned by the Engineering Supervisor or Chief Engineer.
